name: masked-input
purpose: A text field that formats input against a pattern mask (phone numbers, IBANs, postal codes, fixed-shape codes). Typed and pasted characters fill the next free slots, Backspace and Delete skip literals, and the caret keeps its logical position. The value is the raw text; formattedValue adds the literals. A Form control with a hidden input submitting the raw or formatted value.
whenToUse: Values with one fixed shape: national phone numbers, IBANs, postal codes, account or reference numbers.
Codes where showing the separators while typing prevents errors.
whenNotToUse: Dates and times: use Date Input or Date Picker, which validate real dates and respect the business calendar.
Formats that vary a lot (UK postcodes, international addresses, names): use Text Input with pattern or validate.
Numbers with locale grouping and decimals: use Number Input.
rtl: Label and chrome follow the document direction; the value is left to right by default (phone numbers, codes, IBANs), configurable with direction.
theme: Global tokens only (field surface, focus ring, error color). Forced colors use the system colors of the native input.
timezone: Not applicable. The date presets only shape digits; they do not validate dates (use Date Input for that).
security: The value is set as plain text on a native input; custom token patterns are tested one character at a time. No HTML is rendered.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. autocomplete is off unless set (presets set tel and postal-code).

performance.testedScale: Masks up to 64 slots; paste of 1,000 characters.

limitations: Edits are applied through beforeinput, so the browser's undo and redo do not apply to the field (Ctrl+Z does nothing).
Each mask has one shape; optional trailing slots are expressed with minLength (for example IBAN lengths 15 to 34).
IME composition is re-parsed after the composition commits.
unsupported: Alternative masks chosen by the typed value (for example different phone formats per country).
Numeric masks with locale grouping, decimals, or currency.
antiPatterns: Using a mask as the only description of the format (keep the label clear; the format hint is generated for screen readers).
Masking dates instead of using Date Input.
